sources.snippet: MediaPipe-Hand: Gesture Recognition MediaPipe Hands is a real-time hand tracking and gesture recognition framework developed by Google, based on deep learning. This model can detect and track hands using a single RGB camera, identifying 21 key points of the hand and fingers.
